That moment before a spell breaks. The last ember in a forgotten world. The presence you feel before you see it.

Whisp VFX studio creates real-time visual effects for Unreal Engine and Unity. We bring a cinematic eye to the smallest details, shaping effects that belong to your world.

A little darkness.

Our craft

Soul, spells & sorcery +

Expressive magic, spectral trails, and spell impacts with a clear silhouette and a distinct visual identity.

Elemental forces +

Fire, ice, smoke, and energy shaped around your gameplay: from the first anticipation to the final dissipating ember.

Living atmospheres +

Environmental particles, drifting fog, and ambient details that make a space feel inhabited by something unseen.

Built for your world +

Effects for Unreal Engine and Unity, developed around your art direction, gameplay needs, and performance budget.
